name: app
title: Small Start app
description: Write once into an empty folder. The base stays in its package; examples are user files.

files.content:
{
  "name": "tinker-app",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vp dev",
    "build": "vp build",
    "start": "tinker serve",
    "doctor": "tinker doctor",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "postinstall": "tinker prepare"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@tanstack/react-router": "1.170.41",
    "@tanstack/react-start": "1.168.60",
    "@tinker/core": "https://github.com/lagz0ne/tinkered/releases/download/start-v0.7.0/tinker-core-0.7.0.tgz",
    "@tinker/react": "https://github.com/lagz0ne/tinkered/releases/download/start-v0.7.0/tinker-react-0.7.0.tgz",
    "@tinker/start": "https://github.com/lagz0ne/tinkered/releases/download/start-v0.7.0/tinker-start-0.7.0.tgz",
    "react": "^19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "zod": "^4.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^24",
    "@types/react": "^19",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2",
    "vite": "npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@1.0.0",
    "vite-plus": "1.0.0"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "vite": "$vite"
  }
}

# The small app uses the base defaults. No settings are required.
# Uncomment these in .env to choose a host and port.
# HOST=127.0.0.1
# PORT=4318

meta.update: Never re-apply app. Use tinker upgrade for the base and shadcn add --diff for examples.
